name: eomday
expr: v = eomday(Y, M); allMonths2024 = eomday(Yc, Mvec); shapeMat = eomday([2024 2025; 2026 2027], [1 2; 3 4]);
comment: MATLAB eomday: last day of given month. Covered: leap-year all four cases (/4 leap [2024], common [2025], /400 leap [2000], century non-leap [1900]), 30-day month (April), full Jan-Dec scan in leap year, scalar+vector broadcast, and 2x2 matrix shape preservation. Algorithm: lookup table + isLeap = (y%4==0 && y%100!=0) || y%400==0.
